Partial notional is a lower bound; accrual is UPDATE-only and explicitly reports missing row.
Post-fill accrual failure is swallowed and logged.

items.reason: Current inspected callers and sinks still permit lost/unpriced obligations and unrepaired missing accrual rows. The claimed pre-enqueue capacity reservation is not implemented in these paths. This is not a claim that every unknown-capacity input fails open: wholly unassessable primary capacity correctly skips.
items.testGap: Fail cohort write and race fill-before-row creation, then restart. Confirm conservative pending commitments, repair of missing rows, idempotent accrual and no false headroom for partly unpriced obligations.

currentEvidence.observation: Enumeration error returns null; caller emits operator-only plan and later marks source dispatched.

items.reason: Queue retries are not a durable per-user delivery ledger. items.testGap: Enumeration exception, mid-cohort queue failure with first execution completing, accepted exit then authority denial/clean skip/exhausted retry. Require durable, visible repair without blindly resending unknown submissions.
